caption: The drawing depicts a metallic bell with a supporting yoke structure on top. The main body of the bell is conical, widening toward the bottom with a flared edge and showcasing three engraved horizontal lines near the lower rim. The bell is shaded in various tones of gray and black, suggesting a reflective metallic surface. At the top of the bell, a curved yoke with symmetrical, wavy extensions on both sides is attached, depicted in matching metallic shades with distinct highlights and shadows to indicate depth and roundness. The background is plain and off-white, and below the bell, centered text reads "¼" TO THE INCH" in uppercase black letters.
title: Bell - From Swedish Church
